name: Python documentation
capabilities: Download the official Sphinx symbol inventory and search it locally by exact symbol; return a version-pinned documentation URL and anchor.
This route searches named modules/classes/functions; it does not establish full-text topical search or find arbitrary procedural instructions.

query.cost: Public metadata export; no paid service or key used.
query.paging: One bounded metadata inventory; local symbol queries do not issue one network request each.

licensing: Official Python license page contains PSF License Agreement terms and incorporated licenses. Inventory is officially distributed for inter-project references; preserve attribution/version and review licenses separately before copying documentation prose.
limitations: Scope is exact symbols in English Python 3.15 documentation; not a general full-text search API.
One project is one origin; language variants and release versions do not add origins.
Future inventory/version/anchor changes must be revalidated; country-specific browser and accessibility checks remain open.
next_action: Broaden exact-symbol cases and negative/version/anchor checks; complete relevance/access/refresh analysis for this explicitly limited retrieval mode before any integration.

analysis_refs.heading: Implemented and checked locally
analysis_refs.text:
- Redis coordinator, shared record/page caches, stored federation sessions,
  application-wide source counters and their setup/CI prerequisites are removed.
- One live source request per search/detail. Native cursors are signed, bounded,
  context-bound and usable after process restart. Replay makes another request.
- Deterministic tests cover source routing, no fan-out, token tampering/expiry,
  old-session rejection, page cycles/depth, underfilled pages, access classes,
  invalid provider responses, provider errors, cancellation and exact resolution.
- OpenAlex verifies free allowance/known pricing/zero prepaid funds before each
  request. Existing tests reject paid balances, changed prices and exhaustion.
- 570 server tests pass with zero skips; 179 client tests and typecheck pass.
  The disposable PostgreSQL used for existing account regression tests is local
  test infrastructure, not a free-content runtime dependency or hosted resource.
- 62 focused desktop/mobile browser checks pass, including live coverage,
  paging, source switching/website links, reading, save/reload/reopen and three
  reading lights. Full build, isolated client-only build, SEO/deployment checks,
  12 Python importer tests and refresh-script tests pass.

analysis_refs.heading: Reviewed daily refresh
analysis_refs.text:
`python tools/content/refresh_catalogs.py --output-dir /tmp/new-free-candidates`
prepares the three catalog imports in a new directory, preserving the active baseline. Any
source failure, empty/schema-invalid candidate or shrink failure leaves no
published candidate. `node tools/content/audit_snapshots.mjs /tmp/new-free-candidates`
verifies actual source identities, indexing and current reading evidence. Inspect
the report's additions, missing keys and semantic changes before updating files.
Observation-time changes are reported separately from bibliographic changes.

analysis_refs.heading: Free-content implementation validation
analysis_refs.text:
Latest local UI review: **537 server tests (real Redis, no skips), 141 client
tests, 262 broad feature-enabled desktop/mobile browser journeys and 50 focused
feature journeys passed**. All **84 board-state/theme/device captures** pass axe
and overflow checks. See the [screen review and comparison gallery](UI_REVIEW.md).
Typecheck, production build and SEO/deployment checks pass. The unchanged importers
previously passed 12 Python checks; isolated client-only build and pinned actionlint
also passed in the preceding source-expansion checkpoint. CI on
[PR #110](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/pull/110) also runs WebKit
and both disabled/enabled feature paths; consult the PR for the current head.
Hosted enablement and first scheduled refresh execution remain release checks.

analysis_refs.heading: Open Textbook Library follow-up
analysis_refs.text:
Six Python importer tests, 25 focused content/API tests (real Redis included),
510 full server tests, 131 client tests and 14 feature browser checks pass.
Typecheck and feature-enabled production build pass.
The [real textbook flow](evidence/2026-11-01/textbook-flow.json) verifies on
phone/desktop: search → resolve → supplied LibreTexts host link → save → reload
→ reopen, and exact source ISBN `9781946135100` → OTL record 4. No made-up file
download buttons appeared for the host's HTML landing page. There were no browser
page errors or horizontal overflow. These are metadata and browser checks, not
an exhaustive check of every publisher's outbound link.
